errors.evidence: The description assigns a value of 34% to one slice and 33% to the others, implying a difference in size. However, the pie chart clearly shows three equally sized slices, each representing exactly one-third (33.3%) of the total. Assigning different percentages misrepresents the equal weighting of the components.
